title: Gears of War: E-Day

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Xbox Game Studios build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Gears of War: E-Day once the Steam edition ships and can be assessed as a playable accession.
collectionNotes: Digital ownership confirmed via Steam ahead of the announced release. No physical edition is held. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody once the title is released to the account library
preservation.compatibility: Pre-release custody depends on Steam account ownership and the publisher’s eventual unlock of the licensed build.
preservation.concerns: Unreleased digital holdings carry schedule risk in addition to ordinary account-bound platform dependency. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam storefront lists October 6, 2026 as the announced release date and marks the title coming soon. This accession records the licensed pre-release digital holding in custody; playability begins when Steam delivers the released build.
preservation.availability: Held on the archive Steam account; access lasts only as long as that custody and Steam’s service for the title.
